description: What a first-time buyer's PTZ may be, by the rules of offers issued from 1 April 2025 to 31 December 2027 (service-public.fr, checked 15 September 2026): the commune's zone ABC (place, address, lat/lng, or zone), the household's size (persons) and revenu fiscal de référence of year N-2 (income), the operation's cost (cost: price and works, TTC) and the home (kind: new flat in a collective building, new house, an old home with works of at least 25 % of the cost in zone B2 or C, or a social home sold to its tenant): whether the income is under the zone's ceiling, the income counted (the higher of the RFR and the cost divided by 9), the income tranche (1 to 4), the share financed, the cost ceiling, the PTZ's amount, its deferral and repayment (tranche 1: 10 years deferred then 15 years; 2: 8 then 12; 3: 2 then 13; 4: 10 years without deferral) and its monthly payments. The buyer must not have owned their main home in the last 2 years (exceptions: disability, disaster, a home made uninhabitable).

address.description: Street address with its postcode or city (e.g. "17 rue Gambey, 75011 Paris"), located where its sales were recorded (else its street's). Ignored when lat and lng are given.

cost.description: The operation's total cost, TTC: the price, and the works for an old home, in euros.

income.description: The household's revenu fiscal de référence of year N-2 (for an offer in 2026, the 2024 incomes), in euros.

kind.description: new_flat (default: a new home in a building of more than 2 homes), new_house, old_with_works (zones B2 and C), social (a social home sold to its tenant).

place.description: City, city start or postcode (e.g. "Carnac", "Paris 11e", "75011"); with address, the place it is in. Ignored when lat and lng are given.

zone.description: The zone ABC, instead of a place.

name: ptz
title: Prêt à taux zéro (PTZ), France
